_help: Co-op networking config (Netz). Read by scripts/net/net_config.gd (NetConfig.get_value); every key has a constant fallback there, so a missing key or a missing file keeps the defaults. Solo play never reads the co-op sections (downed, points, drops, scaling). Values marked "economy" mean: use the solo value from data/economy.json via Progress.
_help_loading_timeout: loading_timeout_ms: peer timeout while a match scene loads (a big map + nav bake can block the main thread far longer than peer_timeout_max_ms; without this the host dropped every client on rustwell_foundry).

lobby._help_late_join: allow_late_join: a player can join a running match (phase 3a). They get the full world (zombies, doors, drops, round, points, lives, avatars) and spectate until the next round break; joining in a break or before round 1 puts them straight in. Wallet: points.late_join_start.

downed._help: Black Ops style: a player at 0 HP goes down, a teammate holds interact for revive_time_s within revive_range_m; bleed_out_s later they die (spectate until the next round). Game over when everyone is down or dead. Solo keeps the old death = game over.

points._help: Host-authoritative per-player points (Black Ops style). Each accepted hit / kill / revive is credited host-side to the peer who did it; the host replicates every player's total. Spending is a request to the host.

statuses._help: Enemy status ids a client may claim on a zombie (E3; the host applies them with the thrower's avatar as source). Grenades: Shiverglass adds frost.

projectiles._help: Phase 3b (NetProjectiles): host checks on a client's own throw (ThrownProjectile spec). Too far from the thrower's avatar (m), too fast (m/s) or more than max_throws_per_s are refused and logged, never kicked.
projectiles._help_grenades: cooldown_types: player-thrown type_ids on a cooldown; a second throw within grenade_min_interval_s is refused (Ordnance etc. shorten the real cooldown, so this is a loose floor). heal_max_per_s: most HP the host relays to one player per second (Leechbell orbs etc.); more is clipped and logged. A bug guard, not a balance number: well above one Leechbell (its heal comes from grenades.json).
projectiles._help_items: Grenade items (playtest #5): item_types = thrown type_ids whose data is built by the host from the thrower's equipped item (GrenadeItem.throw_data_from_dict). A peer's item update is refused past grenade_item_max_per_s or grenade_item_max_bytes; peers send at most one per grenade_item_min_interval_s. grenade_data_max_bytes caps the grenade data the host sends with each copy.

scaling._help: Zombies per round x (1 + per_extra_player x (players - 1)); max_alive grows the same way, capped at max_alive_cap. Zombie HP unchanged.

spend._help: M13: co-op door buys and paid Field Card rerolls are charged by the host. timeout_s = how long a client waits for the host's answer before the reroll counts as refused (a late yes is refunded); door_retry_s = min gap between door requests per door.

spectate._help: Phase 3a: local spectate camera while you're dead (bled out, or a late joiner waiting for the next round break) and, with when_downed, while downed. Follows an alive teammate from behind the shoulder; next_action / prev_action cycle through them.

avatar._help: Remote players' third-person body (scripts/net/avatar). body = "desi" (assets/models/player/player.glb via NetDesiBody) or "capsule" (placeholder). Walk/run playback is scaled by speed / clip foot speed (Desi: Walk 1.16, CrouchWalk 0.77, Run ~6.2, Sprint ~9.5 m/s).

aim_pitch._help: Remote aim pitch (NetAimPitch): the head pitch split over these bones (weights sum ~1), about the avatar's right axis, after the AnimationTree; alive only.

hit._help: Phase 3d host checks on client hit claims (NetHitCheck): reject + log + count, never kick; generous on purpose. gun = a round of the held weapon (data/weapons.json): range base_range x 4 x range_mult + range_slack_m, damage <= base_damage x headshot x damage_margin, claims/s <= rpm/60 x pellets (x penetrate_hits if penetrate) x rate_margin + rate_slack, light LOS (los_mask world rays from the eye and 4 offsets; blocked only if all stop > los_tolerance_m short). aoe = inside an Explosion, other = skills / abilities / melee (no LOS). weapon_grace_s: a just-swapped weapon still counts.
